result.topic_en: Calculations, dated April 1858, on a system of linear equations in six unknowns $x,y,z,\xi,\eta,\zeta$ with coefficients $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ and their reciprocals, deriving ratios of determinant-like expressions (minors such as (136)/(154)) and product relations among $\beta\beta'\beta''/\gamma\gamma'\gamma''$.
result.transcription:
April 1858
$\overset{1}{x}+\overset{3}{y}+\overset{5}{z}+\overset{2}{\xi}+\overset{4}{\eta}+\overset{6}{\zeta}=0$
(1) $\alpha x+\beta y+\gamma z+\frac{\xi}{\alpha}+\frac{\eta}{\beta}+\frac{\zeta}{\gamma}=0$
$\alpha' x+\beta' y+\gamma' z+\frac{\xi}{\alpha'}+\frac{\eta}{\beta'}+\frac{\zeta}{\gamma'}=0$
$\alpha'' x+\beta'' y+\gamma'' z+\frac{\xi}{\alpha''}+\frac{\eta}{\beta''}+\frac{\zeta}{\gamma''}=0$
(2) $1+\alpha\lambda+\alpha'\lambda'+\alpha''\lambda''=0,\ldots$
(3) $(1+\alpha\lambda+\alpha'\lambda')(1+\frac{\lambda}{\alpha}+\frac{\lambda'}{\alpha'})=\lambda''^2$
(4) $(\alpha+\frac{1}{\alpha})\lambda+(\alpha'+\frac{1}{\alpha'})\lambda'+(\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}+\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'})\lambda\lambda'=(\beta+\frac{1}{\beta})\lambda+(\beta'+\frac{1}{\beta'})\lambda'+(\frac{\beta'}{\beta}+\frac{\beta}{\beta'})\lambda\lambda'=(\gamma+\frac{1}{\gamma})\lambda+(\gamma'+\frac{1}{\gamma'})\lambda'+(\frac{\gamma'}{\gamma}+\frac{\gamma}{\gamma'})\lambda\lambda'$
(5) $1+(\alpha''+\frac{1}{\alpha''})\lambda''=(\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}+\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'})\lambda\lambda'+\lambda^2+\lambda'^2-\lambda''^2$
(6) $(\alpha''+\frac{1}{\alpha''}-\beta''-\frac{1}{\beta''})\lambda''=(\frac{\alpha'}{\alpha}+\frac{\alpha}{\alpha'}-\frac{\beta'}{\beta}-\frac{\beta}{\beta'})\lambda\lambda'$
$\frac{(\frac{1}{\gamma}-\alpha)(\alpha'-\beta')+(\frac{1}{\gamma'}-\alpha')(\beta-\alpha)}{(\frac{1}{\beta}-\alpha)(\alpha'-\gamma')+(\frac{1}{\beta'}-\alpha')(\gamma-\alpha)}=[-\pm-]\frac{(136)}{(154)}=\frac{(\frac{1}{\gamma}-\alpha)(\alpha''-\beta'')+(\frac{1}{\gamma''}-\alpha'')(\beta-\alpha)}{(\frac{1}{\beta}-\alpha)(\alpha''-\gamma'')+(\frac{1}{\beta''}-\alpha'')(\gamma-\alpha)}=\frac{(\alpha\beta\gamma')}{(\alpha\gamma\beta')}$ und (2)
(7) $=\frac{(\frac{1}{\alpha\gamma}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\gamma'})(\alpha''-\beta'')+(\frac{1}{\gamma''}-\alpha'')(\frac{\beta}{\alpha}-\frac{\beta'}{\alpha'})}{(\frac{1}{\alpha\beta}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'})(\alpha''-\gamma'')+(\frac{1}{\beta''}-\alpha'')(\frac{\gamma}{\alpha}-\frac{\gamma'}{\alpha'})}$
$\frac{(\alpha''-\beta'')(\frac{1}{\beta''}-\alpha'')}{(\alpha''-\gamma'')(\frac{1}{\gamma''}-\alpha'')}=\frac{(\frac{1}{\alpha\beta}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'})(\frac{\beta}{\alpha}-\frac{\beta'}{\alpha'})}{(\frac{1}{\alpha\gamma}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\gamma'})(\frac{\gamma}{\alpha}-\frac{\gamma'}{\alpha'})}$ = aus (6)
$\frac{\frac{1}{\alpha\gamma}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\gamma'}}{\frac{1}{\alpha\beta}-\frac{1}{\alpha'\beta'}}\cdot\frac{\alpha''-\beta''}{\alpha''-\gamma''}=\frac{(136)}{(154)}=\frac{(\frac{1}{\gamma''}-\alpha'')(\frac{\beta}{\alpha}-\frac{\beta'}{\alpha'})}{(\frac{1}{\beta''}-\alpha'')(\frac{\gamma}{\alpha}-\frac{\gamma'}{\alpha'})}$ aus (6) und (7)
$\frac{\alpha\gamma-\alpha'\gamma'}{\alpha\beta-\alpha'\beta'}\cdot\frac{\frac{1}{\alpha''}-\frac{1}{\beta''}}{\frac{1}{\alpha''}-\frac{1}{\gamma''}}=\frac{(245)}{(263)}=\frac{(\gamma''-\frac{1}{\alpha''})(\frac{\alpha}{\beta}-\frac{\alpha'}{\beta'})}{(\beta''-\frac{1}{\alpha''})(\frac{\alpha}{\gamma}-\frac{\alpha'}{\gamma'})}$
$\frac{\beta\beta'\beta''}{\gamma\gamma'\gamma''}=\frac{(136)(236)}{(254)(154)}$
$\beta\beta'\beta''\gamma\gamma'\gamma''=\frac{(135)(235)}{(264)(164)}$
$-\alpha\alpha'+\alpha\beta'-\frac{\beta'}{\gamma}-\frac{\alpha'}{\gamma}$
$+\alpha\alpha'+\alpha'\beta-\frac{\beta}{\gamma'}-\frac{\alpha}{\gamma'}$
$\beta\beta'\gamma(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\gamma)(\alpha\frac{1}{\beta}\frac{1}{\gamma})-\alpha\alpha'(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\gamma)(\frac{1}{\alpha}\beta\frac{1}{\gamma})=(\alpha\beta-\alpha'\beta')\Big[(\alpha'+\frac{1}{\alpha'}-\beta'-\frac{1}{\beta'})(\gamma+\frac{1}{\gamma}-\alpha-\frac{1}{\alpha})-(\alpha+\frac{1}{\alpha}-\beta-\frac{1}{\beta})(\gamma'+\frac{1}{\gamma'}-\alpha'-\frac{1}{\alpha'})\Big]$

methods.what: Homogeneous linear system in six unknowns with coefficients $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ and reciprocals
Ratio of minors expressed in coefficients
Product formulas for coefficients in terms of minors
Identity expressing combination of 3x3 determinants as product
